propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF through production codec paths, achieving idempotent Markdown↔ADF round-trip including combined-mark bodies.
Data Center safe Markdown descriptions and comments must render as Jira wiki markup through production codec paths with zero monotonic length decay over repeated passes.
Bidirectional sync must suppress echo loops and unchanged second-pass updates using per-binding baselines and change-gated rich_sha, while flagging concurrent local and remote edits as conflicts.
Rich-text sync must preserve Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) when rebar-originated reconciliation reads Jira-authored content.
DC renderer must safely handle dangerous prose, ASCII tables, and missing pandoc with subprocess timeouts and fallback without data loss.
Test fixtures must be stratified, scrubbed, committed under version control at measured cardinalities, and remain under 500 KB per file per pre-commit gate.
